extra.final_summary: The data had two issues: (1) 'Torgerson' and 'Bisco' in the 'island' column were misspellings of 'Torgersen' and 'Biscoe', which were corrected; (2) one row (row 10) had an impossible body mass of 4,000,000 g, which was excluded. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was calculated: Biscoe: 38.58 mm, Dream: 39.49 mm, Torgersen: 38.34 mm.
